column1: # PIN.tsv — the machine-readable half of PROVENANCE.md.
# One row per frozen artifact. The pin is recorded PER FILE, not per directory, so a partial move
# (one coherent (ROM, listing) pair ahead of the rest) is expressible rather than requiring a new
# format. Today all six rows sit at one chain; the shape does not depend on that staying true.
# Read by:
#   crates/oracle-replay/tests/aeon_pin.rs   — verifies every sha256 and NAMES THE CHAIN in the
#                                              default suite's output (so a green cannot be read as
#                                              a statement about aeon's master)
#   crates/oracle-core/tests/symbols_real_lst.rs — prints it (does not judge it)
#   tools/aeon_pin_report.py                 — the non-gating currency reporter (asks sigil at TIP
#                                              whether it has moved past these rows)
# Columns, tab-separated:
#   file          the artifact's name in this directory
#   sha256        of the committed bytes
#   bytes         size, recorded so a truncation is visible without hashing
#   chain         sigil freeze-chain number == the count of `[[entry]]` blocks in that revision's
#                 crates/sigil-harness/golden/provenance.toml (derived, not transcribed: verified at
#   sigil_freeze  the sigil commit whose golden set defines that chain
#   aeon_rev      the aeon tree state that build came from — ATTRIBUTION ONLY, nothing resolves it
#   authority     sigil-golden-blob = taken with `git cat-file -p <rev>:crates/sigil-harness/golden/<f>`
#                 aeon-build-tree   = copied from a clean aeon worktree at that chain's aeon_rev
#   upstream      the path inside sigil's golden directory this row can be checked against at tip,
#                 or `-` when sigil freezes no such artifact (every `.lst`: sigil's golden set carries
#                 ZERO listings at any revision checked, so their currency is UNMEASURABLE from sigil
#                 and the reporter must say so rather than render it as agreement)
